notes.title: Update Version 0.23
notes.notes:
- Fixed performance issues 
- Reworked boxlock, now it is much more efficient at holding your containers on your forks
- Moved obtainable breaker map

If you have any feedback or suggestions you want to add, fill this form out, reply in the comments of the announcement, or post to the community hub:

Google form: https://forms.gle/NBn6eD5SFy65BWC17



Known Issues:
- Audio settings don't apply after launching the app, only after entering the level


Controller players:
1. Enable Steam Controller Input (Right click the game in your library > Properties > Controller)
2. Click use Controller Configurator
3. Click current button layout
4. Navigate to the Community Layouts
5. Select Show All Layouts
6. Select the controller configuration or create one (There is 1 already published)
7. You're done

notes.title: Update Version 0.22
notes.notes:
Update Version 0.22 notes:
- Added obtainable map in the office
- added boxlock tooltip if you're experiencing troubles grabbing containers, remember to have boxlock disabled before grabbing another container. 
- Forklift throttle reworked to be more gradual and less hi-lo

If you have any feedback or suggestions you want to add, fill this form out, reply in the comments of the announcement, or post to the community hub:

Google form: https://forms.gle/NBn6eD5SFy65BWC17



Known Issues:
- Audio settings don't apply after launching the app, only after entering the level
- Performance issues on first night start, to fix this start the night and after loading in return to menu and start again, this will create a save. *Only happens on the first time you start a night /after you die and have to restart* if you have started one previously/continuing your night you shouldn't experience this. If you do, restart the app and everything should run much smoother, especially after an update.


Controller players:
1. Enable Steam Controller Input (Right click the game in your library > Properties > Controller)
2. Click use Controller Configurator
3. Click current button layout
4. Navigate to the Community Layouts
5. Select Show All Layouts
6. Select the controller configuration or create one (There is 1 already published)
7. You're done
